title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2607.28640v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should exhibit cross-modal consistency, generating consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images, resulting in sequences where visual tokens are interleaved with text tokens. Based on TokenSwap, we transform existing text-based benchmarks (e.g., MMLU) into image-interleaved counterparts, resulting in TokenSwap-Bench. translated_title: TokenSwap：多模态大语言模型中模态差距的基准测试与缩小
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）应当表现出跨模态一致性，即在语义等价但模态不同的输入下生成一致的响应。然而，我们观察到模型预测在这类跨模态变化下存在系统性差异。具体而言，我们将“模态差距”定义为模型在语义等价的文本输入与多模态输入下的性能差异。我们提出TokenSwap方法，通过用语义对齐的图像替换文本概念来构建此类输入，从而得到视觉token与文本token相互交错的序列。基于TokenSwap，我们将现有的基于文本的基准（如MMLU）转换为图像交错的对应版本，构建出TokenSwap-Bench。在对42个多模态大语言模型的评测中，我们观察到普遍存在的模态差距：当输入从纯文本转变为图像交错形式时，模型性能下降4.2%至47.4%，平均下降19.6%（±3.3%）。
tldr: 本文提出TokenSwap方法，通过将文本基准（如MMLU）中的文本概念替换为语义对齐的图像，构建出图像交错的TokenSwap-Bench基准，首次系统揭示了42个多模态大语言模型中普遍存在的模态差距，即图像交错输入相比纯文本输入平均导致19.6%的性能下降。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TokenSwap, a method that transforms text-based benchmarks like MMLU into image-interleaved counterparts (TokenSwap-Bench), systematically revealing a pervasive modality gap across 42 multimodal LLMs, with performance dropping by an average of 19.6% when text concepts are replaced with semantically aligned images.
